Sacramento Bike Hikers Tuesday Evening Ride

Gold River, CA · Road

Sacramento Bike Hikers Tuesday Evening Ride is a road group ride in Gold River, CA. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:00 pm from Gold River Town Center, Bel Air parking lot. About 20 miles, about 15 mph average.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 15 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Sacramento Bike Hikers Tuesday Evening Ride group ride

An evening loop on the American River bike trail: Gold River down to the fish hatchery, out to William Pond Park and back. 20 miles at about 15 mph. The Bike Hikers call themselves the longest-running bike club in the Sacramento area. Registration not required.
